description: This file defines the 'EcuDefinition' interface in the 'com.romraider.logger.ecu.definition' package, outlining methods related to ECU (Engine Control Unit) definitions.

classes.name: EcuDefinition
classes.description: Interface for ECU definition objects, specifying methods to access ECU identification, calibration, car info, inheritance info, and ECU definition file.

methods.name: getEcuId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the ECU.

methods.name: getCalId
methods.description: Returns the calibration ID associated with the ECU.

methods.name: getCarString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the car associated with the ECU.

methods.name: getInherits
methods.description: Returns the inheritance information for the ECU.

methods.name: getEcuDefFile
methods.description: Returns the File object representing the ECU definition file.
